verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's cloud directory page says it consolidates "all identities—human, machine, and agent" into one source of truth, so agents are at least named as a directory identity type. Its password vault stores company secrets in general, but nothing ties it to agent token vaulting. Missing for 10: documented patterns for securing agent access to apps, cross-app access for agents, agent-specific token vaulting, scoped/short-lived agent credentials, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
